title: Pregnancy Recipes: Iron-and-Folate Bowls You Can Cook in 30 Minutes
excerpt: Three tasty recipes pairing heme/non-heme iron with vitamin C — Vietnamese-inspired bowls with clear amounts and food-safety notes.
content:
## Introduction
When pregnant, a woman's diet plays a crucial role in the development of her baby. Iron and folate are two essential nutrients for fetal development. In this article, we will introduce three delicious and iron-rich recipes that can be cooked in under 30 minutes.

## Nutrient Analysis
Iron and folate are two critical nutrients for pregnant women. Iron helps create red blood cells, while folate helps prevent neural tube defects in the baby. To enhance iron absorption, pregnant women should combine iron-rich foods with vitamin C-rich foods.

## Recipe 1: Grilled Chicken and Vegetable Bowl
* 100g grilled chicken
* 1 cup cooked white rice
* 1 cup mixed vegetables (carrots, green beans, broccoli)
* 1 orange

Grilled chicken is an excellent source of heme iron, while mixed vegetables and orange provide vitamin C to enhance iron absorption.

## Recipe 2: Beef and Vegetable Stir-Fry Bowl
* 100g beef stir-fry
* 1 cup cooked white rice
* 1 cup mixed vegetables (carrots, green beans, broccoli)
* 1 lemon

Beef stir-fry is an excellent source of heme iron, while mixed vegetables and lemon provide vitamin C to enhance iron absorption.

## Recipe 3: Vegetarian Red Bean and Vegetable Bowl
* 100g cooked red beans
* 1 cup cooked white rice
* 1 cup mixed vegetables (carrots, green beans, broccoli)
* 1 orange

Cooked red beans are an excellent source of non-heme iron, while mixed vegetables and orange provide vitamin C to enhance iron absorption.

## Food Safety Notes
When pregnant, women should be mindful of food safety to avoid bacterial infections and other health issues. Ensure that all foods are cooked thoroughly and hot before consumption.

## Conclusion
The three recipes above provide a rich source of iron and folate for pregnant women, supporting fetal development. Remember to combine iron-rich foods with vitamin C-rich foods to enhance iron absorption.
